about: Register of the reading capabilities imported from Crawler 7d091ef into engine-ts/ (O-1), what Pee actually uses, and what was demonstrated, where and with which metric. Owner decision 2026-10-23 (definitive): a Pee reader, parser, extractor or assimilation path may not duplicate or replace one of these capabilities without a preservation record (preservation/records/) that compares the old path, the new path and a selective integration on the same inputs. Evidence below is quoted from Pee reports only; Crawler's own historical metrics were never re-measured in Pee and are not listed. Figures from different evaluations are never comparable with each other.

operational_routes.A (owner documents, assimilation): markdown.py -> propositions.py + knowledge_acquisition.py -> represent. Uses no engine-ts module.
operational_routes.B (pages, acquisition): acquisition.py reads a structure file. In I-1/I-2 that file came from engine-ts structural readers (1F, 1G document model) through experiments/i1/crawler_structure.mjs; their interpretations were not exported. No permanent interface exists.

areas.capability: Table grid with cell coordinates, spans and header cells; heading tree, section paths, structured names (HTML)
areas.pee_use: experiment adapters (I-1, I-2); R-1 interface experiments/r1/crawler_tables.py + engine-ts/pee-tools/tables-bridge.mjs, not on the operational path (R-1 decision: blocked)

demonstrated.what: equivalence with Crawler on 11 Crawler fixtures x 8 entry points, 88/88 identical
Markdown-to-HTML adapter + 1F on 42 owner-document tables: 2,078 cells identical to markdown.py's reading (rows, columns, headers, text, heading paths); no links present

areas.capability: Whole-table interpretation: roles of headers (product, property, condition), evidence classes, conditions, table relations (verified relative differences, statistic rows), lessons

demonstrated.what: 10 of 108 traced statements are extracted only by 1G; on one review 1G finds 2,056 values (Phase245: 539), 0 reach Pee
roles: good on one publisher, mixed on another, wrong on benchmark charts; 749 table derivations on one review
Pee's own placement of 1F structure: 15 of 61 V1 table statements complete and correct
Pee's Markdown table reader (D-2): 5 of 513 rows of three owner packages acquired as single values; 63 not assimilated
demonstrated.kind: Pee path, coverage count only. Never compared with 1G: a preservation gap

demonstrated.what: 10 sealed Markdown scientific tables, 56 reference values: 1G found 34, fully correct 0, critical errors 9, spurious 4; no property assigned (record axes)
demonstrated.kind: Claude-written reference on spent material; not independent. Says nothing about HTML product tables

areas.capability: Label-value specification extraction and value normalisation (numbers, ranges, bounds, units)
areas.pee_use: X2 read Crawler's stored records and its segmentation (reuse verdict: neutral); not in an operational route

demonstrated.what: limit checks on records Crawler had already extracted: Crawler 14 justified / 2 unjustified, Pee 18 / 1, of 75
demonstrated.kind: measures the decision layer over extracted records, not reading

demonstrated.what: 79 limit checks: Crawler 7 justified / 0 unjustified; reuse of segmentation changed no answer
same sealed tables: every value with a unit that 1G read was also read by Pee's parser (0 values from 1G only)

areas.capability: Test measurements, comparative results, quantity knowledge, knowledge rules and links, product facts, extraction plans, compound conditions

demonstrated.what: imported tests and outputs equivalent to Crawler
demonstrated.kind: regression evidence only; no Pee measurement of reading quality

areas.capability: Qualitative observations, review semantics, observation semantics and reconstruction
Scientific prose to statements: knowledge translation, document evidence, atomic context evidence, review document engine, scientific reading, definitions

demonstrated.what: speakers compendium prose, 238 sealed reference propositions (§5.1): faithful items T 13 of 92, A-1 98 of 280, hybrid 66 of 286; precision (F2) T 0.141, A-1 0.350, hybrid 0.231; faithful coverage (F3) T 0.038, A-1 0.298, hybrid 0.189; critical errors (F1) T 6, A-1 15, hybrid 23 (negation: T 0, A-1 8). Crawler made fewer critical errors but far fewer faithful items
demonstrated.kind: prose only. Says nothing about tables or specifications. Correction 2026-10-23 (owner): an earlier version gave the critical-error counts (6, 15) as faithful statements

areas.capability: Entity inventory, document semantics, context graph, discourse and reference hypotheses, claim attachment

demonstrated.what: imported for the tests; equivalence only

areas.capability: Retention policy of what may be stored

gated_new_files.about: A new file in these directories is a new reader or reading component: it must address every area listed.
